thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx and upstream timeouts seen at ingress-proxy cluster (us-east-1). Error rate ~18% last 5m. Paging oncall.
alyssa: @here acked, I'm on it. grabbing logs + quick topo.
samir: +1, looking at backend fanout and upstream latency. any customer reports yet?
maria: CS says two customers reported degraded API responses ~10:13p ET. collecting request IDs.
alyssa: top-line: 502/504s concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat routes. tail latency for upstream A (model-proxy-1) shows 1.2s->6s.
ops-lead: mark customer-impacting. start mitigation playbook: ingress fallback, traffic-shift, and reduce parallel fanout.
alyssa: running quick healthcheck: `curl -sS https://ingress-us-east.service/status` -> `{ "ok": true, "connections": 654 }` but upstream health shows degraded: see logs.
infra-bot: sample log: `{ "ts":"2026-03-17T22:12:31Z","req_id":"r-9a3b","upstream":"model-proxy-1","status":504,"lat_ms":6023 }`
samir: looks like model-proxy-1 returning timeouts under load. can we temporarily shift route weights away from model-proxy-1 to model-proxy-2?
alyssa: trying weight rebalance now via route-manager: `rbctl set-weight ingress/prod model-proxy-1 10` then `model-proxy-2 90`. will monitor.
ops-lead: also enable degraded-mode for heavy endpoints (switch to non-blocking generation path). runbook: https://playbook.internal/ingress-deg-mode
maria: notifying affected accounts: sending a short note to top 5 customers and open a CS ticket. @customer-success please paste template.
customer-success: sending now to customers with incident id INC-2278901234. template: "We're seeing elevated 5xxs on ingestion; we're mitigating by shifting traffic and enabling degraded paths. ETA preliminary 30-45m."
alyssa: weight change applied. initial metrics: 5xx down from 18% -> 9% in 2m. good direction.
samir: still seeing occasional 504s from model-proxy-2 but lower. suspect connection pool exhaustion on model-proxy-1 earlier caused errors cascade.
infra-bot: `netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l` on model-proxy-1 returned 1840 (normal 600-800).
ops-lead: open port for autoscale to add one more replica for model-proxy-1 as long term fix. create infra ticket.
alyssa: scaling model-proxy-1 +1 pod. command: `k scale deploy/model-proxy-1 --replicas=4 -n prod`
maria: CS updated customers with mitigation steps and a note that we're monitoring.
customer-success: one customer asks if data was dropped — please confirm.
alyssa: no data loss expected; requests that timed out get 5xx - we are retry-safe in client SDK but will follow up with per-request logs if they want.
samir: adding temporary connection pool limit on ingress to avoid head-of-line blocking: `proxy.conf.max_conn=1200 -> 800` (rolling). testing on canary.
ops-lead: good. set postmortem owner to @samir and timeline owner to @maria.
alyssa: metrics now: 5xx ~4% last 5m, P95 latency reduced 18%. continuing monitoring.
infra-bot: autoscale event fired, new model-proxy-1 pod ready (10:26p ET).
maria: CS: customers acknowledged, one asks for ETA on full recovery. i'll give 1-2 hours and promise follow-up.
alyssa: final step: keep degraded-mode for 30m, then re-evaluate rollback to normal routing.
ops-lead: agreed. incident severity: Sev2 -> mitigation active. next update in 15m or on major change. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2278901234 created and pinned to channel. summary: upstream timeouts caused 5xx spike at ingress; traffic shifted, degraded paths enabled, autoscale added; customer notifications sent.
samir: postmortem checklist items: load test model-proxy, increase connection pool headroom, add circuit-breaker earlier in fanout, improve alert thresholds to detect rising conn counts.
maria: assigning follow-ups: `POSTMORTEM-227890` assigned to samir/infra/maria.
alyssa: thanks team. monitoring for 30m then close if stable. :coffee:
